FIELDS.NAME: CineSphere Video Rentals
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
CineSphere Video Rentals operates as a retail video and media store offering a diverse selection of films, video games, and related merchandise for rent and purchase. Our operations are anchored in delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining a secure and welcoming environment for all patrons. We implement strict age verification protocols for age-restricted content, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements. 

Our stores are equipped with professionally monitored burglar and fire alarm systems and security cameras covering all public areas to enhance safety and loss prevention. Our team undergoes thorough training in customer service, safety procedures, and loss prevention to minimize operational risks. We also maintain robust inventory management systems to ensure accurate tracking and auditing of stock. 

CineSphere strives to stay current with business operation laws, including copyright and licensing regulations, further solidifying our commitment to responsible retailing. Special events hosted at our locations are conducted with appropriate permits and security measures in place to ensure the safety of our customers and staff. Overall, we layer operational controls to mitigate risks while providing our community with high-quality media products and services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Theft of merchandise occurred on 05/12/2023, with a loss amount of $2,000; currently under investigation. Water damage caused by a faulty sprinkler system on 06/15/2022, resulting in $3,000; resolved with repairs completed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-rated, UL-listed safe, Class 350, secure for media storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Professional security monitoring service for enhanced loss prevention.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. Our focus is solely on retail video and media sales, ensuring a safe environment for our customers.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its marketing or operational activities. Our focus is on providing quality media products and services to our customers.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The Operations Manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property related to the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – CineSphere Video Rentals has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We have maintained a good standing with our insurance provider and uphold all necessary compliance measures.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not lease employees to or from other employers as part of its business operations. We maintain our own staff to provide exceptional customer service and manage store operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – CineSphere Video Rentals carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements for employee protection and ensure a safe working environment.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – CineSphere Video Rentals also operates CineSphere Media Productions, LLC, which focuses on media production services. This business complements our retail operations by enhancing our content offerings and market presence.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – CineSphere Video Rentals currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. All insurance coverage is consolidated under our primary policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – CineSphere Video Rentals is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are strictly focused on retailing video and media products.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its business operations, focusing solely on retail video and media products for customer use.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – CineSphere Video Rentals has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial standing remains stable, and we continue to operate successfully.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retail video and media products. We maintain all necessary safety protocols to ensure a secure environment for our customers and staff.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – CineSphere Video Rentals does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations do not involve activities that increase such risks. We focus on retail video and media sales in a secure environment.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – CineSphere Video Rentals has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations emphasize compliance and employee training to mitigate such risks.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – CineSphere Video Rentals currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
